# OpenLaunch SDK

> Open-source TypeScript space-computation SDK for spaceflight data, SGP4/SDP4 satellite tracking, space-traffic geometry, Earth observation, geospatial intelligence, weather, mission analysis and spacecraft engineering.

## Start here
- README.md — package overview and API guide
- examples/README.md — categorized cookbook with self-contained examples
- examples/catalog.json — machine-readable example metadata
- examples/AI_INDEX.md — AI-oriented usage rules, units and modeling assumptions
- docs/EXPORTS.md — public export inventory
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — SDK architecture
- docs/PROVIDERS.md — LL2, NASA and CelesTrak provider notes
- docs/VALIDATION.md — validation boundaries
- docs/EARTH_INTELLIGENCE.md — STAC, Copernicus, Planetary Computer, weather and EO orchestration
- docs/ORBIT_TRAFFIC.md — SGP4/SDP4, passes, closest approach, RTN, sensor access and CZML

## Canonical source
- src/index.ts — root public exports
- src/client.ts — OpenLaunch client and provider/resource wiring
- src/providers/ — LL2, NASA, CelesTrak, STAC, Copernicus, Planetary Computer and Open-Meteo integrations
- src/geo/ — reusable WGS84 AOI primitives
- src/eo/ — scene ranking and spectral-index helpers
- src/intelligence/ — cross-provider Earth intelligence workflows
- src/orbit/ — SGP4/SDP4, frame transforms, ground tracks and pass prediction
- src/traffic/ — closest approach, RTN geometry and bounded catalog screening
- src/sensors/ — swath/off-nadir access geometry and sensor presets
- src/scenario/ — multi-object orbital scenarios and Cesium CZML export
- src/resources/ — high-level and raw resources
- src/science/ — deterministic engineering and math helpers

## Examples by task
- examples/00-getting-started/ — client basics
- examples/01-launch-library/ — LL2 launch/agency/astronaut/event/pad/raw/config use
- examples/02-nasa/ — NASA Open APIs
- examples/03-celestrak/ — OMM/catalog access
- examples/04-orbital-mechanics/ — orbital and transfer calculations
- examples/05-rocket-engineering/ — rocket equation, staging and delta-v
- examples/06-spacecraft-engineering/ — power, RF, thermal, structures, reliability, life support, data and radiation
- examples/07-gnc-math/ — vectors, matrices, quaternions, PID, Kalman and numerics
- examples/08-geodesy-visibility/ — WGS84, ECEF/ECI and visibility
- examples/09-atmosphere-edl/ — atmosphere, aerodynamics and entry/descent helpers
- examples/10-astronomy-time-units/ — unit conversion, Julian/sidereal time and astronomy
- examples/11-integrated-missions/ — multi-module architecture examples
- examples/12-sdk-infrastructure/ — cache and telemetry patterns
- examples/13-earth-observation/ — STAC, Sentinel-1/2, Landsat, weather windows and cross-provider monitoring
- examples/14-orbit-traffic/ — SGP4 states, passes, traffic screening, sensor access and 3D scenarios

## Important limitations
OpenLaunch is not flight-qualified software. Use the v0.7 SGP4/SDP4 layer for GP-element tracking rather than the older two-body approximation. Miss distance is not collision probability; covariance is required for probabilistic conjunction analysis. Sensor geometry is not proof of tasking/acquisition. Validate independently for safety-critical use.
